div.head: IV As 6.2c
div.ab: ⁊ sece swylce socne swylce he sece, þæt he ne sy his feores wyrðe, butan swa feola nihta swa we her beufan cwædon.
⁊ sece swylce socne swylce he sece, þæt he ne sy his feores wyrðe, butan swa feola nihta swa he we her beufan cwædon.
But let him seek what sanctuary he may, his life shall be spared only for as many days as we have declared above.
Und jener [Verbrecher] mag, welche Zuflucht immer er auch suche, aufsuchen: dass er seines Lebens nicht [länger] sicher sei als so viel Tage, wie wir hier oben bestimmt haben.
And whatever sanctuary that [criminal] may seek: that he is not secure of his life [any longer] than as many days as we determined here above.
